This upgrades \u201c`T \u22a2 \u03c6`\u201d to \u201c\u03c6 is true of the integers\u201d.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Status summary\\n\\n| Tier | Obligations | Count | Status |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| A | O0 | 4 | pending \u2014 discharged by kernel run |\\n| A | O1 | 3 | pending \u2014 discharged by kernel run |\\n| A | O2 | 11 | pending \u2014 discharged by kernel run |\\n| A | O3 | 2 | pending \u2014 discharged by kernel run |\\n| A | O4 | 3 | pending \u2014 discharged by kernel run |\\n| B | O5 | 3 | pending \u2014 review + spot check |\\n\\nAll 26 obligations must be discharged before the informal claim in `claim.md`\\ncounts as formally verified. O2.1\u2013O2.10 and O1 carry the only mathematical\\ncontent; the remainder are structural bookkeeping enforced by the kernel.\\n\",\"path\":\"obligations.md\"}"
